current.selection_policy: Up to three geographically nearest stations in the NWS returned station list; not a validated representativeness or hazard-coverage ranking.
current.quality_policy: Native NWS quality_control flags are retained. No additional station QC or roof-height correction is applied.

forecast.precipitation_probability_definition: NWS probability of measurable precipitation (at least 0.01 inch liquid equivalent) for the source forecast interval; not percent of time raining or a hail probability.

alerts.matching_method: Official NWS /alerts/active?point query; includes provider polygon/county/zone applicability. No local polygon filtering.
alerts.status_meaning: An empty successful response means no active alerts returned by NWS for this point at fetch time; it does not mean no weather hazards. A failed request has unknown current alert status.

freshness_policy.note: Illustrative freshness limits, not validated hazard-response thresholds. A fresh nearby station is not a measurement at the selected roof.

limitations: The selected pin is precise; station observations and grid forecasts do not measure exact weather at that roof.
No live radar, hail-size estimate, lightning detections, roof-level winds, or parcel-level weather accuracy claim is supplied by this prototype.
Hourly forecast periods are preserved; no interpolation into invented minute-by-minute forecasts.
Freshness is shown separately from successful retrieval. Policy limits are illustrative and require operational validation.
